findings.activeCall: telemarketing_calls.status=in_progress is the open-call lock (unique index one_open_per_employee). getOpenCallForEmployee filters that status. A pending report is still in_progress with ended_at set.
findings.claimedLead: telemarketing_lead_directory.claimed_by / claimed_at. Assignment assigned_to is separate and must not change.
findings.timers: Call timer starts at startCall insert (started_at=now). Report timer starts at endCall (report_started_at=ended_at). No cap today. Submit uses wall-clock stampReportSubmit.
findings.noPstn: This product is a work timer, not a phone switch. startCall immediately inserts in_progress and UI shows השיחה פעילה. There is no answered/connected event.
findings.task3SafeWindow: Cancel after התחל שיחה is allowed only while ended_at IS NULL AND elapsed < 15 seconds. After סיום שיחה or after 15s, only super-admin reset can unstick. Released status is excluded from reports/timeline/performance.
findings.reports: dialAttempts currently counts every loaded call including in_progress. completed-only adds seconds. Released must be skipped so void/reset is not a fake dial.
findings.desktopHole: Agent home lg:grid-cols-2 with 3 items (lead already open) leaves the last card on one side. Directory+customer only-child has the same hole.

significantLogic: Adding status=released is a small schema CHECK expansion, not a report-formula rewrite. Completed rows are never released. No import/dedup/follow-up/traffic changes.
